subject.title: fix(memory-core): unify QMD multi-collection search, add phase timings, fix archived-session identity loss

question: Should the new `MemorySearchRuntimeQmdDebug` fields become a supported public memory-host SDK contract, or should this PR keep the diagnostics internal and land only the retrieval repair?
rationale: The patch explicitly exports public types and changes a plugin-facing runtime-debug payload; code review cannot safely choose the long-term external contract on maintainers’ behalf.

options.title: Keep diagnostics internal
options.body: Remove or defer the new public SDK fields and land the QMD search and archived-session repair without committing to a host-facing debug schema.

options.title: Approve the SDK contract
options.body: Accept the additive QMD debug fields as supported API and require maintainer-visible contract documentation plus compatibility-focused coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep diagnostics internal
recommendation.body: Remove or defer the new public SDK fields and land the QMD search and archived-session repair without committing to a host-facing debug schema.

likelyOwner.reason: A current-main memory-core and memory-host SDK owner should make the external-contract decision; available context does not establish a specific person.
